review_candidates.description: About The Company Samay Consulting is a leading technology solutions provider dedicated to delivering innovative and reliable software services to clients across various industries. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and technological excellence, Samay Consulting has established itself as a trusted partner for digital transformation initiatives. Our company values a collaborative work environment, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence, enabling us to attract top talent and deliver impactful solutions to our clients. About The Role We are seeking experienced Backend Java Engineers to join our Sustainment & Enhancement Squad. This role primarily involves supporting, maintaining, and improving integrations with Oracle Retail Cloud MFCS. The position offers an engaging mix of support-heavy tasks and development responsibilities, with a focus on ensuring the stability and performance of critical backend services. The successful candidates will work in a dynamic environment, troubleshooting complex issues, implementing fixes, and contributing to system enhancements. This is a full-time remote opportunity open to candidates based in India, with shift timings available in the morning and afternoon shifts. Candidates should be comfortable participating in a shared on-call rotation and be available to join within 30 days or less. Qualifications To be considered for this role, candidates should possess 4 to 7 years of professional experience in Java backend development and production support. A strong hands-on background with Java, Spring Boot, and Kafka is essential. Candidates should have a solid understanding of REST APIs, service-to-service communication, and distributed backend systems. Proficiency in SQL and relational databases is required, along with experience debugging and resolving production issues. Familiarity with application logs, monitoring tools, and root cause analysis techniques is important. Knowledge of integration patterns, testing practices, and cloud platforms is a plus. The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to work independently, escalate issues appropriately, and participate actively in on-call support. Responsibilities In this role, your key responsibilities will include developing a comprehensive understanding of Oracle Retail Cloud MFCS, its APIs, and related integration points. You will monitor and troubleshoot integrations with MFCS and other backend services, analyzing logs, database queries, API responses, and Kafka events to identify issues. Troubleshooting across multiple services will require diagnosing whether problems originate within applications, databases, or external systems. You will participate in incident resolution, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence. You will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing existing Java and Spring Boot applications, including bug fixes, minor feature additions, and performance optimizations. Developing and maintaining unit and integration tests will be essential to ensure system reliability. Additionally, you will adhere to coding standards, participate in code reviews, and contribute to documentation and monitoring practices. Collaboration with senior engineers, L3 support teams, and other stakeholders will be crucial when deeper technical investigations or architectural modifications are needed. Participation in on-call support will also be part of your responsibilities, ensuring timely communication and escalation of production issues. Benefits At Samay Consulting, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well-being and professional growth. Our employees enjoy competitive salary packages, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for continuous learning through training and development programs. We promote a healthy work-life balance with paid time off, health insurance coverage, and wellness initiatives. Being a remote-first organization, we provide the necessary tools and support to ensure a productive and comfortable work environment. Additionally, employees have access to career advancement opportunities within the company, fostering long-term growth and success. Equal Opportunity Samay Consulting is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and excellence, and we are dedicated to creating a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best.

Have experience of teaching the EYFS statutory framework, through Continuous Provision. Demonstrate a secure understanding of assessment and EYFS outcomes. Specialist lessons for Arabic, PE, Music, and Library form part of students’ personalised timetables, supporting further our broad and balanced curriculum offer. Qatar International School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Application and interview Please submit your application and make sure to upload your updated CV. Initial interviews may be conducted online or face-to-face if the candidate is in Qatar. review_candidates.title: ERSOU - ROCU - Police Staff SO2 - Enhanced Intelligence Officer
review_candidates.description: Bedfordshire Police Police Staff Permanent Full Time ERSOU - Regional Organised Crime Unit Stevenage SO2 £42,612 Weekend Working Allowance 48.24 37 The Role This is an exciting opportunity to be part of the Sensitive Intelligence Unit (SIU) as an Enhanced Intelligence Development Officer. The role is open to experienced Intelligence Development Officers The Sensitive Intelligence Unit is a fascinating and exciting place to work. The department is a unique function within Policing and across the Eastern Region, providing specialist intelligence support to ROCU and Force led operations as well as supporting partner agencies in their fight against serious and organised crime. The SIU is dedicated to supporting operations tackling the highest harm and threat areas, across multiple crime types, exploiting and enhancing intelligence from multiple sensitive data sources in order to provide key stakeholders with the best opportunities to conduct enforcement, recover assets, seize criminal commodity and bring offenders to justice. We provide intelligence support to Crime In Action investigations (kidnap and extortion) as well as supporting the prevention, mitigation and management of Threats to Life (TTL) in order to safeguard vulnerable people. Managing intelligence against tasked operations across the Eastern Region, you will gain first-hand knowledge of Serious and Organised Crime detection and disruption techniques and conduct intelligence collection against Organised Crime Groups (OCG’s) involved in firearms and drugs importation/supply, organised immigration crime/human trafficking, modern day slavery, child sexual exploitation, cyber enabled criminality and financial crime across the region. The work conducted by the SIU delivers significant operational results day in day out. The SIU can often be an exhilarating and fast-moving working environment where innovation, problem solving and the use of the latest technology and intelligence techniques are utilised to keep up with the ever-growing complexity and sophistication of serious organised crime. You can expect a varied and fulfilling career within this business area, with no two days ever being quite the same. Your work will be fundamental in contributing to the impressive results that make the headlines and your role will be integral in the disruption of organised crime in the Eastern Region. The role involves undertaking an 8-week rotational shift pattern as the SIU operates between the hours of 8am and 6pm. You will work a mix of 8am-4pm/8am-4.30pm/9.30-6pm shifts including an on- call weekend (Fri-Sun) and a weekday on-call (Mon-Thurs). Tackling serious and organised criminals requires applicants to be able to be flexible to meet operational demands (sometimes at short notice). Type Of Person We Want We want colleagues to apply for this role who are professional, excellent communicators and with a thirst for knowledge and professional development. Diligence and a strong team work ethic are key. Innovative ways of thinking and problem solving are desirable. We are recruiting for an experienced intelligence officer who can demonstrate an aptitude for intelligence research and an investigative mindset combined with the ability to learn. Experience within a covert environment is desirable but not essential. A full training pathway and mentoring will be provided to the successful candidates, and they will be expected to attain IPP accreditation if not already held. A flexible approach to the working day is required due to the potential for extended hours. ERSOU – Who Are We And What We Do Created in 2010, ERSOU is funded by the seven police forces that make up the eastern region, with Bedfordshire Police being the lead force. ERSOU is the Eastern Region Special Operations Unit, that oversees and delivers a regional level response to Serious and Organised Crime, and Counter Terrorism Policing for the Forces in the Eastern Region. ERSOU is made up of both Officers and Police Staff from across the entire region and works closely with the 7 Forces and National Partners. The departments are unique, in that they offer opportunities to work and develop individuals professionally in specialist areas, often delivering capabilities that are provided by local forces. Working for ERSOU presents a fantastic opportunity for you to learn and develop within a unique law enforcement community whose staff and officers are dedicated to protecting the public from the threat of terrorism and serious and organised crime. We are committed to building a leadership team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from individuals who are currently underrepresented at senior levels, including women, Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic candidates, disabled people, and those from LGBTQ+ communities. We value the unique perspectives and experience that diverse leadership brings and welcome candidates who can help us drive inclusive policing and community engagement. ERSOU as an employer can offer. Blue light card discounts Generous pension scheme Opportunities to get involved with networking groups such as the network of women, LGBTQ+, parent, carers, health, and wellbeing. What To Include In Your Application You will be expected to provide written evidence (max. 500 words each) on the following from the role profile: Minimum entry standards CVF - We take ownership CVF - We are collaborative When writing your answer for the CVF, please try to give us one clear example of a situation or task you’ve undertaken, giving detail of what you completed and how. Vetting Applicants must hold or be prepared to undergo Management Vetting (5 years residency criteria) and Security Clearance (5 years residency criteria) or Development Vetting, if applicable, before taking up the post. Please be aware the Police Corporate Vetting Unit will undertake security vetting on successful candidates, their family and others that live at their home address, which will include financial checks. Due to the sensitive nature of these checks, we are not able to supply feedback should clearance be declined. This post is designated a ‘reserved post’ under the Civil Service Nationality Rules and is open only to UK Nationals. Anyone holding dual nationality can make an application but may be required to relinquish non-British nationality if successful (and any entitlement you may have to a foreign nationality) as a condition of your confirmation of appointment with CTP. When applying please click Yes to the British Nationality Question in order to progress to the next step of the application process. One of your parents should also be British or have substantial ties to the UK. In the latter instance; substantial ties mean that your parent is a citizen of a British Overseas Territory, a Commonwealth citizen, US citizen, EEA citizen, British national or citizen overseas, and they would need to have demonstrable connections with the UK by way of family history or have been resident here for a substantial period of time. If you’re already married to, or cohabiting with, a person who isn’t a British citizen, you may still be eligible for employment at the discretion of the department. You should note however, that marriage to, or cohabitation with, a person who isn’t a British citizen after appointment may, in some circumstances, result in the withdrawal of security clearance and subsequent transfer to another department, or (if this is not possible or the officer does not wish to transfer) dismissal. Each case will be considered on its merits, considering the ties between the person involved and the United Kingdom. For Further information Email us at ASK.ERSOU@beds.police.uk , emails will be forwarded on to the relevant recruiting manager and we will endeavour to reply within 3 working days. Additional Information All internal applicants must have successfully completed their probationary period to apply for this role. Internal applicants within Bedfordshire Police, Cambridgeshire Constabulary or Hertfordshire Constabulary (BCH), should upload either a CV or provide relevant skills, experiences and qualifications on Word/PDF document. This vacancy is live to those at risk of redundancy and will remain open to redeployees until the conditional offer stage throughout the recruitment process. Redeployees will take priority over other applicants at any point during the recruitment process up until conditional offer. If a redeployee is successful and accepts an offer, they will remain on their home force’s terms and conditions. As a Disability Confident leader, we take personal responsibility to help create an inclusive workplace, where police officers and staff respect one another, feel valued for their differences and can be themselves. We are committed to providing workplace adjustments, wherever needed so everyone feels welcome and can flourish. If you have a disability and you meet the minimum criteria for the position you are applying for, you will be entitled to an interview under the ‘Offer an Interview Scheme’. It is recommended that you download and store a copy of the role profile as this will no longer be available once the advert has closed.

review_candidates.title: Downstream Transport Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Ești pasionat(ă) de logistică, ai spirit analitic și îți dorești un rol în care acțiunile tale au un impact direct atât asupra satisfacerii clienților, cât și asupra mediului? Căutăm un Downstream Transport Coordinator dedicat, care să preia frâiele operațiunilor de transport (local și regional) și să ne ajute să construim o rețea de distribuție mai rapidă, mai eficientă și mai verde! 🎯 Care va fi rolul tău? Ca Downstream Transport Coordinator , vei fi puntea de legătură între depozite, magazine, clienți B2B și partenerii noștri de transport. Vei asigura derularea impecabilă a livrărilor zilnice, vei optimiza costurile și vei contribui la reducerea amprentei de carbon prin soluții inteligente de transport. 📋 Responsabilitățile Tale Principale 💼 Operațiuni & Coordonare zilnică Planificare: Organizezi și monitorizezi fluxurile zilnice, săptămânale și lunare de transport B2B și retururi. Gestiune & Administrare: Verifici și validezi facturile de transport, previi costurile suplimentare și rezolvi eventualele neconcordanțe sau litigii cu transportatorii. Siguranță & Conformitate: Te asiguri că protocoalele de siguranță la încărcare/descărcare sunt strict respectate și gestionezi procedurile vamale acolo unde este cazul. 📊 Performanță & Satisfacția clienților Monitorizare SLA: Urmărești îndeaproape timpii de livrare (Promised vs. Actual Lead Time) și indicatorii de performanță (B2B DOT). Eficientizare: Lucrezi împreună cu echipele din depozit pentru optimizarea gradului de încărcare al camioanelor — mai puține curse, consum redus de combustibil și mai puține emisii de CO2! Parteneriate: Organizezi întâlniri periodice de evaluare (QMR) cu furnizorii de transport și gestionezi procesele de despăgubire pentru marfă deteriorată sau pierdută. 🚀 Strategie & Dezvoltare Sustenabilitate: Implementezi soluții de transport ecologice pentru reducerea emisiilor de $CO_2$ pe tonă/articol. Achiziții: Sprijini echipele de Procurement în organizarea licitațiilor de transport și evaluarea pieței. Optimizare continuă: Propui soluții noi de transport și contribui la dezvoltarea unui panel de transportatori fiabili pe termen lung. 👤 Ce căutăm la viitorul nostru coleg / viitoarea noastră colegă? Experiență: Studiile sau experiența anterioară în Supply Chain, Transport & Logistică (gestionarea proceselor End-to-End). Limbi străine: Limba engleză la nivel B2 (scris și vorbit – esențială pentru activitatea zilnică). Abilități tehnice: Cunoștințe solide de operare a datelor de transport, înțelegerea reglementărilor în transporturi și gestiune bugetară. Soft Skills: Capacitate excelentă de organizare și rezolvare eficientă a problemelor. Abilități de comunicare și negociere în relația cu furnizorii externi și departamentele interne. Adaptabilitate la situații neprevăzute și atenție la detalii. Orientare către sustenabilitate și îmbunătățire continuă. 🎁 Ce Oferim un mediu de muncă activ cu posibilități multiple de dezvoltare; program de lucru variat și flexibil, în 2 schimburi; training-uri locale și naționale; teambuilding-uri și întâlniri cu echipa pentru a practica sport împreună; asigurare medicală privată; asigurare de viață; reducere la produsele mărci proprii; program intern de recomandări viitori angajați, cu recompensă financiară; bonuri de masă/tichete cadou; pachet salarial individualizat, bazat pe propriile performanțe; bonus lunar, în funcție de performanțe; oportunitatea de a investi în companie prin sistemul de acționariat; posibilitatea de a primi parte din profitul companiei prin sistemul profit sharing. bonus de relocare. Dacă te regăsești într-un mediu dinamic, ai putea descoperi că Decathlon este locul perfect pentru tine. Aici, vei găsi o cultură primitoare, construită pe valorile noastre și consolidată de o pasiune comună pentru sport, ce asigură o experiență de dezvoltare pentru fiecare.

review_candidates.title: Disponent / Disponentin (m/f /d)
review_candidates.description: Gestalte die operative Exzellenz unserer Material- und Auftragsprozesse – werde Teil unseres Teams! Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Material- und Auftragsdisposition und möchtest deine Expertise in einem internationalen, professionellen Umfeld einbringen? Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, arbeitest strukturiert und trägst aktiv zur Stabilität und Leistungsfähigkeit operativer Prozesse bei? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Wir sind das Finance and Procurement Services (FPS) Team innerhalb von Siemens Global Business Services (GBS) und unterstützen die Siemens-Geschäftsbereiche weltweit durch effiziente, standardisierte und qualitativ hochwertige operative Services. Für unseren Bereich suchen wir eine erfahrene Disponentin / einen erfahrenen Disponenten (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Material- und Auftragsdisposition. Deine Aufgaben Eigenverantwortliche operative Planung, Steuerung und Überwachung von Materialien und Aufträgen innerhalb des zugewiesenen Verantwortungsbereichs. Sicherstellung der termingerechten Materialverfügbarkeit unter Berücksichtigung von Bedarfen, Beständen, priorisierten Aufträgen und definierten Service Levels. Proaktives Monitoring offener Aufträge sowie frühzeitige Identifikation und professionelle Bearbeitung von Abweichungen, Engpässen und Risiken. Enge fachliche Abstimmung mit internen Schnittstellen wie Einkauf, Produktionsplanung, Fertigung und weiteren operativen Einheiten. Sicherstellung hoher Datenqualität durch Pflege und Analyse von Dispositions-, Auftrags- und Stammdaten in den relevanten Systemen (z. B. SAP). Aktive Mitwirkung bei der Stabilisierung, Standardisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Dispositions- und Auftragsprozessen. Unterstützung bei operativen Auswertungen, KPI-Analysen und Reportings. Funktion als fachliche Ansprechperson im operativen Tagesgeschäft. Das bringst du mit Ausbildung Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder logistische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erfahrung und Fachkenntnisse Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Material- oder Auftragsdisposition, Supply Chain Management oder Produktionsplanung. Sehr gutes Verständnis operativer End-to-End-Prozesse im industriellen Umfeld. Sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS-Office-Anwendungen. Gute Kenntnisse in SAP (z. B. MM, PP, SD). Gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil. Arbeitsweise Strukturierte, analytische und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise. Hohes Maß an Eigenständigkeit und Entscheidungsfähigkeit im operativen Umfeld. Kommunikationsstärke sowie ausgeprägte Schnittstellen- und Teamfähigkeit. Hohes Qualitäts-, Service- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Bereitschaft und zeitliche Flexibilität für gelegentliche Dienstreisen, insbesondere nach Deutschland, im Rahmen der Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern und Fachbereichen. Was wir bieten Mitarbeit in einem stabilen, internationalen Unternehmen. Interessante und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem professionellen Umfeld. Attraktives Vergütungspaket. Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle inkl. Home Office. Zugang zu Mitarbeiter-Aktienprogrammen. Und vieles mehr! Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen! What is Siemens offering beyond great career opportunities? More time to rest Up to 33 days of vacation (5 weeks of holiday + up to 8 extra days from the benefits budget). The option to take unpaid leave for rest or travel. Flexibility and home office Flexible working hours and the ability to work from home, with a contribution towards home office expenses. Individual Benefits Budget Personal budget of at least CZK 34,000 to buy selected benefits from categories finance, wellbeing and health. My finance Contributions towards pension and/or life insurance and/or DIP (a long-term investment product) from your benefits budget. Employee stock ownership plan – share in the company’s success. My wellbeing Cafeteria system from the benefits budget. Meal e-vouchers. Company nursery in Ostrava to support working parents. Exclusive employee offers and discounts. My health Discounted MultiSport card. The option of access to premium healthcare and crisis support (e.g., psychological counseling). Siemens is an equal opportunity employer. We promote equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We are committed to forming a diverse team that represents various perspectives and skills. Problem solvers and entrepreneurs are welcome. Discover our exciting world at Siemens at www.siemens.com

review_candidates.title: Director, Oracle Accounting Hub
review_candidates.description: The role involves leading Oracle Cloud Financials projects, including strategy, implementation support, and ERP optimization for Finance and Procurement functions. Key responsibilities include managing project activities, supervising staff, supporting business development, and ensuring data integrity and security within Oracle Cloud applications. Qualifications required are at least eight years of Oracle ERP experience, with a strong focus on Financial implementation and upgrades, preferably involving full Oracle Cloud Financials deployments. Skills needed include deep understanding of Oracle Cloud ERP systems, excellent verbal and analytical abilities, and leadership capabilities. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship and demonstrate professionalism and integrity in their work environment. This position offers opportunities for professional growth within a collaborative culture, with a comprehensive benefits package and a focus on personal development.
